_doc: 2D wing-section test (option B of the wing-separation diagnosis, 2026-11-22): the 3D p14 runs show the MP4/23 rear wing stalled, the RB12 rear wing stalled inboard and its front-wing flaps separated, the MP4/5 front main plane separated inboard, the MCL39 attached. Each case builds the car (same geometry as p14), cuts two sections at the stations of the 3D wing-section lines (all wall surfaces, enclosed = solid, gaps < 2 mm closed as in the 3D mesh) and runs them in 2D (gmsh -> gmshToFoam -> simpleFoam, 50 m/s, moving ground under front wings): bl = y+ ~1 layers, iso = 0.1 mm triangles, iso_sa = Spalart-Allmaras, coarse = 5.3 mm like the 3D wing cells, iso_m5 = 5 deg less incidence. Geometry or mesh: if the fine sections stall too, it is the drawn geometry; if only coarse does, the mesh.
